Enabled, automatic Catalog, native sources off, AV1, WebRTC and HTTPDNS blocking on, verbose off, schema 2.
Eleven built-in hosts, four default unavailable.
README controls, mode names, reset/clear behavior and entry labels match current sources.
Four GM keys; current composition and sole-writer boundaries match guides.
Ordered native position/rate/progress checks, one correction per field after at least 1000 ms, ownership checks and read-only progress evidence are documented; no new policy introduced.
Schema 6 / buffer-window-v6 remains diagnostic and does not authorize predictive rescue.
Nineteen suites and documented CLI/exit codes; verify does not include Codex Security or browser acceptance.
Published source acceptance, normal installed regression, fixed tag and one script asset match existing sealed evidence; no re-execution.
Human-confirmed permission propagation followed by successful ordinary local verification; initial failure and limits remain historical.
No predictive adoption; old windows and matrices remain stopped. New installed fault validation is a suggestion, not an active task.
